Name: Exolunar Arcanist
Information:
**Exolunar Arcanist**

An exolunar arcanist channels the arcane energies of a cosmos, focusing on astromancy and the effects that the exolunar void have on magic. They sometimes appear more scientifically minded than other arcanists, even beside the already formulaic nature presented by other wizards.

“When science and arcanics meet, the result is always beautiful. All who reach beyond their worlds require both, and both are truly one and the same. There’s little to gain in trying to separate technology and magic.”

traits.name: Concentration Expert
traits.description: The arcanist has advantage on concentration checks.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.description: The arcanist is a 10th level wizard. Their spellcasting ability is Intelligence (save DC 16, spell attack +8). They have the following spells prepared:

actions.name: Multiaction
actions.description: The arcanist makes three Cosmic Burst attacks, or makes one Cosmic Burst attack and casts one spell with a casting time of 1 action using its Spellcasting trait.

actions.name: Cosmic Burst
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target, or as a Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d12 + 4) radiant damage.

bonus_actions.name: Cosmic Step
bonus_actions.description: The arcanist teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet (90 feet if the space is in a zero-gravity environment).

reactions.name: Countercast (Recharge 6)
reactions.description: The arcanist produces the effects of the counterspell spell, requiring no spell slot and using Intelligence as their spellcasting ability. They cannot automatically negate the triggering spell, and must roll an ability check against it even if its spell level is 3rd or lower.
